post.summary: Upload an answer key or sample (PDF or image; owning college only)
post.description: The request body is the file itself. The file type is read from its content. `confirm_no_student_data` must be true: keys are written by faculty and hold no student data (C9).

get.summary: Download an answer-key file

post.summary: Upload a reference diagram as PNG (owning college only)
post.description: The request body is the PNG. Its nodes, edges and labels are read from the picture by the worker (recognition `pending` until then); check and correct them through `/graph/edits`. `kind` says what it is (circuits, plots and labelled drawings are kept but not compared yet). `confirm_no_student_data` must be true (C9).

403.description: Another college owns it: copy it first.

422.description: A rule is broken; the message says which.

get.summary: Download a reference diagram PNG

post.summary: Upload a booklet: one PDF, or the page images in order
post.description: `files` is one PDF, or JPEG/PNG images in page order (the order sent is the page order). The type is judged from the file's content. The booklet is queued for page cleaning (status `uploaded`). The same file hash within the college is refused with 409 unless `allow_duplicate` is true; a teacher may have a limited number of booklets waiting (429 beyond it).

409.description: The same file was uploaded before (`duplicate_of` lists the booklets)

429.description: You already have the maximum waiting

get.summary: Your college's booklets with their processing status, newest first
One booklet with its pages, their measurements and retake reasons

delete.summary: Delete a booklet: images, text and marks go; a content-free record stays

get.summary: The cleaned page image (or the original with `kind=original`)
What OCR read on one page: every line with every engine's reading and score
get.description: Lines keep every engine's reading, the selector's terms for each, the chosen one and whether the line is flagged for the teacher. Tables come as a `table` region followed by its cells (`parent_id`, `row`, `col`). Empty until the page has been read.

post.summary: Go on with a page the quality gate flagged
post.description: Overrides the retake request for that page. When no flagged page is left the booklet moves to `pages_ready`. Recorded in the audit log.

get.summary: The reference diagram's graph (latest version)

post.summary: Correct the reference graph or change its kind (owning college only)
post.description: Applies the edits in order and stores the next version. Add, remove, relabel or reshape nodes; add, remove or relabel edges; reverse an arrow; re-attach an arrow's ends. Removing a node removes its edges. Scores already made keep the version they used.

422.description: An edit names an unknown node or edge, or a label is too long.

409.description: The graph changed since it was loaded (reload and edit again).

post.summary: Read the reference PNG again (owning college only)
post.description: Queues recognition; the worker stores the result as the next version, replacing any edits in that version (earlier versions are kept).

get.summary: The diagrams recognised in a booklet

schema.title: Response Booklet Diagrams Api V1 Booklets  Booklet Id  Diagrams Get

post.summary: Correct a recognised drawing; its answer is re-scored
post.description: Applies the edits in order (as for the reference) and bumps the version. Needs the booklet's lock (423). The answer is re-scored in the background; an approved answer must be reopened first (409).

422.description: An edit names an unknown node or edge, or a label is too long.

409.description: The graph changed since it was loaded (reload and edit again).

get.summary: The R6 comparison documents of the answer's latest score
get.description: One per diagram criterion that was compared; criteria left to the teacher (no reference graph, no drawing) have none.

schema.title: Response Diagram Comparisons Api V1 Booklets  Booklet Id  Answers  Answer Id  Diagram Comparisons Get

post.summary: Open a booklet for review (take or refresh its lock)
post.description: The first open of a scored booklet starts its review (`in_review`). Call it again to keep the lock while reading (every write also refreshes it). Unapproved answers whose key, rubric, glossary or reference diagram changed since they were scored are sent for re-scoring (`rescoring`, `notices`).

delete.summary: Close a booklet (release the caller's lock)
delete.description: Nothing happens when the caller holds no lock on it.

get.summary: The review of a booklet: answers, suggestions, approvals, totals, sheets, lock
